64.name: Context Not Found
64.meaning: The referenced GTP context does not exist on the receiving node.
recommended_checks: Verify whether the session was deleted earlier.
Compare request frame with previous session creation messages.

72.name: System Failure
72.meaning: The receiving node reported an internal system failure.
recommended_checks: Check node health and overload state.
Inspect peer logs around the failure timestamp.
Verify whether the failure is isolated or repeated.

93.name: APN Access Denied
93.meaning: The subscriber is not allowed to access the requested APN.
recommended_checks: Check APN spelling and roaming restrictions.
Confirm policy control response for the session.
